source.paper: Boore, Stewart, Seyhan & Atkinson (2014) Earthquake Spectra 30(3) 1057-1085, Eq.(2)-(8)+(13)-(17)
source.basis: scalar transcription of the hazardlib implementation (BooreEtAl2014, region=nobasin, sof=True; independent of physics.js); regenerate by re-transcribing if hazardlib updates

units: lnA: pga = ln(median PGA in g), pgv = ln(median PGV in cm/s), SA = ln(median PSA in g) — hazardlib native; physics.js wrappers convert g -> gal with 980.665
